name: Doja Prepackaged Flower | Orange Zkittlez
description:
Zkittlez x Mimosa

Citrus sweetness blends with a tart marmalade finish that smells like an orange popsicle. The taste is like a sour blood orange mixed with corn syrup and leaves a candied citrus flavor in the mouth for long after the smoke has cleared. The effect is invigorating and cerebral but has enough power in the smoke to satisfy the most particular palettes.
